pipSettings.title: Customize Pip
pipSettings.lead: Choose where Pip appears in the chat and in setup, the faces it makes and how it moves. A change applies at once and is saved for this Project.
pipSettings.rowLabel: Customize Pip: {text}. Open the Pip editor
pipSettings.playWhy: Turn on State faces to see the team work.
pipSettings.stageLabel: Preview: a small team in the chat
pipSettings.reach: Parts change Pip in the chat and in setup. Pip’s mark, the app icon, the tray and loading signs stay as they are, and every helper is still a Pip.
pipSettings.motionNote: Reduce motion is on, so these stay still. Your choices are kept for when it is off.
pipSettings.soundNote: Pip sounds only while sound is on for this Project; muting the chat’s speaker mutes Pip too.

full.label: Full
full.help: Everything but chirps in the app

quiet.label: Quiet
quiet.help: Pip where work is; no reactions

plain.label: Plain
plain.help: No extras; helpers are still Pips

themeMenu.customizeLabel: Customize Pip: where it appears, its faces and how it moves
